title: IBM Cloud Pak for Data System 11.3.1.2 Interim Fix 001 through - 11.3.1.2 Interim Fix 002 could allow a user with…
description: IBM Cloud Pak for Data System versions 11.3.1.2 Interim Fix 001 through 11.3.1.2 Interim Fix 002 contain a vulnerability that allows users with administrative privileges to read and write arbitrary files due to incorrect permission assignments. This could lead to unauthorized data access and modification within the system.
